enemies.name: Arc
enemies.title: The Beginner Scout
enemies.intro: Arc steps onto the training field. Your first lesson begins now.
enemies.victory: Arc falls back. Your fundamentals are solid.

enemies.name: Jay
enemies.title: The Digital Glitch Warrior
enemies.intro: Jay cracks the air with violet static. Packet switching is about to get serious.
enemies.victory: Jay shatters into sparks. The network is yours.

enemies.name: Pat
enemies.title: The Final Boss
enemies.intro: Pat appears in the frozen core. One final check on internet architecture awaits.
enemies.victory: Pat collapses into the dark. You mastered the lesson.
